question: The mode of the observations 1, 1, 8, 3, 1, 3, 4, 3, 9, 9, 4, 3, 2, 2 and 6 is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Count the occurrences of the most frequently repeating numbers directly from the given set.

The number 1 appears 3 times.

The number 3 appears 4 times.

All other numbers (2, 4, 6, 8, 9) appear 2 times or fewer.

Since 3 has the highest frequency, it is the mode.

**∴ The correct answer is 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Observations: 1, 1, 8, 3, 1, 3, 4, 3, 9, 9, 4, 3, 2, 2, 6

**Formula Used:**

Mode = The observation that occurs with the highest frequency in a given data set.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let us tabulate the frequency of each distinct value present in the data:

⇒ Observation 1 → Occurs 3 times

⇒ Observation 2 → Occurs 2 times

⇒ Observation 3 → Occurs 4 times

⇒ Observation 4 → Occurs 2 times

⇒ Observation 6 → Occurs 1 time

⇒ Observation 8 → Occurs 1 time

⇒ Observation 9 → Occurs 2 times

⇒ By comparing the frequencies, we observe that the value 3 occurs the maximum number of times (4 times).

**∴ The correct answer is 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mode

The mode is the value that appears most frequently in a data set. A given set of data may have one mode (unimodal), two modes (bimodal), multiple modes, or no mode at all.

Median

The median is the exact middle value when a data set is ordered from least to greatest. If the total number of elements is even, it is the average of the two central values.

Mean

The mean is the mathematical average of a set of numbers, calculated by dividing the total sum of all observations by the number of observations.

Empirical Relationship

For any moderately skewed statistical distribution, the relationship between measures of central tendency is given by: Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean.
